contract: 2026-09-05 incident fix: hybrid (multi-group) KV invalid-block recovery no longer crashes the engine on single-group unpack; external KV load failures retry with a fresh lookup before recompute; session-tagged requests' freed blocks are protected from prefix-cache eviction; LMCache heartbeat PING timeout is decoupled from the ping interval and logs its failure reason. Additionally, a failed retrieve on the healthy path now reports its GPU blocks as load errors (previously logged and dropped, resuming generation on garbage KV).
